title: Meta's multibillion-dollar Nvidia deal sends a signal the chip giant's rivals can't ignore
title_zh: Meta 价值数十亿美元的 Nvidia 交易发出了一个信号，这家芯片巨头的竞争对手不能忽视
summary: As AMD shares fell and Google's TPU ambitions stalled, Meta's commitment to Nvidia's full chip stack amounts to a strong vote of confidence that should (at least temporarily) settle investor nerves For Nvidia Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA, XETRA:NVD), the timing could hardly be better.
summary_zh: 随着 AMD 股价下跌和谷歌 TPU 野心陷入停滞，Meta 对 Nvidia 完整芯片堆栈的承诺相当于投下了一张强有力的信任票，这应该（至少暂时）安抚投资者的紧张情绪。对于 Nvidia Corp（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA，XETRA：NVD）来说，时机再好不过了。

title: Dow Jones Futures: Meta-Nvidia Deal Lifts Nvidia, Hits AI Rivals
title_zh: 道琼斯期货：Meta-Nvidia 交易提振 Nvidia，打击人工智能竞争对手
summary: The still-divided stock market reversed higher for slim gains Tuesday. Nvidia rose late on a Meta AI deal, but AMD and Broadcom slumped.
summary_zh: 周二，仍存在分歧的股市反转走高，小幅上涨。 Nvidia 因 Meta AI 交易而上涨，但 AMD 和 Broadcom 下跌。

title: Blackstone Nears $2.5 Billion Deal for Champions Group
title_zh: Blackstone 接近以 25 亿美元收购 Champions Group
summary: Private equity firm said to be close to acquiring landscaping services provider.
summary_zh: 据称私募股权公司即将收购园林绿化服务提供商。

title: Blackstone Inc (BX) Strikes Big Deal in Women’s Healthcare Space
title_zh: Blackstone Inc (BX) 在女性医疗保健领域达成重大交易
summary: Blackstone Inc (NYSE:BX) is one of the best NYSE stocks to buy for the long term. Blackstone Inc (NYSE:BX) led a $10 billion debt investment in the Australian AI infrastructure company Firmus, Reuters reported on February 9.
summary_zh: 黑石公司（纽约证券交易所代码：BX）是最适合长期购买​​的纽约证券交易所股票之一。据路透社 2 月 9 日报道，黑石公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）牵头对澳大利亚人工智能基础设施公司 Firmus 进行了 100 亿美元的债务投资。
